// Generated by fizzyx. Do not edit.

import "server-only"
import { cookies } from "next/headers"

const config = {{FIZZYX_AUTH_CONFIG}} as const
const accessCookie = "fizzyx_admin_access"
const refreshCookie = "fizzyx_admin_refresh"

function apiBaseUrl(): string {
  const value = process.env.API_BASE_URL
  if (!value) throw new Error("API_BASE_URL is required for server-side admin authentication")
  return value
}

function readPath(value: unknown, path: string): unknown {
  return path.split(".").reduce<unknown>((current, key) => current && typeof current === "object" ? (current as Record<string, unknown>)[key] : undefined, value)
}

const cookieOptions = { httpOnly: true, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production", sameSite: "lax" as const, path: "/" }

export async function loginAdmin(input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<boolean> {
  const response = await fetch(new URL(config.loginPath, apiBaseUrl()), {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(input),
    cache: "no-store",
  })
  if (!response.ok) return false
  const payload: unknown = await response.json()
  const accessToken = readPath(payload, config.accessTokenPath)
  if (typeof accessToken !== "string" || !accessToken) return false
  const store = await cookies()
  store.set(accessCookie, accessToken, cookieOptions)
  if (config.refreshTokenPath) {
    const refreshToken = readPath(payload, config.refreshTokenPath)
    if (typeof refreshToken === "string" && refreshToken) store.set(refreshCookie, refreshToken, cookieOptions)
  }
  return true
}

export async function hasAdminSession(): Promise<boolean> {
  return Boolean((await cookies()).get(accessCookie)?.value)
}

export async function clearAdminSession(): Promise<void> {
  const store = await cookies()
  store.delete(accessCookie)
  store.delete(refreshCookie)
}

export async function proxyAdminRequest(request: Request, path: string[]): Promise<Response> {
  const method = request.method.toUpperCase()
  if (!["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"].includes(method)) {
    const origin = request.headers.get("origin")
    if (origin && origin !== new URL(request.url).origin) return Response.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  }
  const token = (await cookies()).get(accessCookie)?.value
  if (!token) return Response.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 })
  const incoming = new URL(request.url)
  const upstream = new URL(path.map(encodeURIComponent).join("/"), `${apiBaseUrl().replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
  upstream.search = incoming.search
  const headers = new Headers({ authorization: `Bearer ${token}` })
  for (const name of ["accept", "content-type"]) {
    const value = request.headers.get(name)
    if (value) headers.set(name, value)
  }
  const response = await fetch(upstream, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: ["GET", "HEAD"].includes(method) ? undefined : await request.arrayBuffer(),
    redirect: "manual",
    cache: "no-store",
  })
  if (response.status === 401) await clearAdminSession()
  const responseHeaders = new Headers()
  for (const name of ["content-type", "content-disposition"]) {
    const value = response.headers.get(name)
    if (value) responseHeaders.set(name, value)
  }
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers: responseHeaders })
}
